Priya: Quick sync — SP region final QA today. Owners please confirm routing policy + data residency sign-off. CRs merged? :eyes:
Max: Routing PR merged to main but infra needs to apply egress ACLs and NAT rules. Pinged infra. snippet:
```yaml
routes:
  - prefix: /api/sp
    region: sa-east-1
    priority: 10
    fallback: us-east-1
```
Max: Also noticed higher KV cache miss rate in canary logs, might be config mismatch.
Samir: I'll take KMS + DB replica work. ETA EOD for key provisioning and replica bootstrap. Need net-team to open 2 ports (5432 + 1024-2048 for replication).
Olivia: Legal has reviewed retention & data transfer rules. Approved: logs retention 90 days, no cross-region export without C2 approval. @Priya share the final text for customer comms. :white_check_mark:
Priya: Thanks. @Olivia can you drop a short blurb we can reuse for support docs?
Olivia: Posting blurb in #help in 10m.
Samir: CR-4879 (KMS + IAM perms) in, awaiting @Max review. CR-4880 (db-replica) ready for infra approvers.
Max: Reviewing CR-4879 now, will push review comments within the hour.
deploy-bot: Smoke run 1 started. Results:
- canary-1: health=PASS
- canary-2: health=FAIL (KV cache OOM in lmk-service)
Logs:
```
2026-03-17T15:02:21Z lmk-service ERROR kv_cache: eviction-failure OOM
```
Priya: Ok we need triage on KV OOM before wide rollout. Max will try a config bump for cache size, Samir will check node memory and swap.
Max: I'll open a hotfix CR for cache config and run a quick canary by 18:00 UTC.
Samir: I'll provision an extra 8GB on canary nodes and validate db replication network.
Priya: Plan:
- Samir: KMS + DB network done by 18:00 UTC
- Max: cache hotfix + CR merge by 18:00 UTC, run smoke canary at 19:00 UTC
- Olivia: final comms blurb by 16:00 UTC
If all green, target canary rollout to 5% traffic at 20:00 UTC. Anyone blocking? :point_up:
Max: No blockers from eng after I push fixes.
Olivia: No blocks from legal.
Samir: Will need a quick net-team ack after ACLs applied. Pinging @net-team.
Priya: Great — I'll update the region rollout doc and post final checklist here when net ack is in. :v:
__note: This file is a single Slack thread, messages in chronological order, formatted as a continuous string with sender prefixes.
